recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the remaining active cross-page application for FHIR-17036 without duplicating the already-published FHIR-13426 and FHIR-25438 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-17036 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested that the Composition description in the Bundle boundaries section be changed because the existing wording described only a single logical document with clinical attestation; the resolution was to make it compatible with the Composition page scope.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-17036 source commit was found. The underlying Composition definition had been generalized by the related FHIR-13426 history, and the current combined branch already contains FHIR-13426 and FHIR-25438 reconciliation commits, but active Bundle/List/Group introduction pages still retained the old copied wording.
additional_context: Composition, Bundle, List, and Group are active resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-13426 established the logical-package wording and FHIR-25438 later replaced clinical-attestation language with author traceability; both are already represented on the combined branch and provide the current wording family to align to. Direct FHIR-17036 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml, source/list/list-introduction.xml, and source/group/group-introduction.xml to describe Composition as a logical package with author traceability and to condition the FHIR document structure statement on document use.
source_changes: source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml: updated the Composition relationship text in Bundle boundaries to use logical-package, author-traceability, and conditional document wording.
source/list/list-introduction.xml: updated the parallel Composition relationship text to match the current Composition scope.
source/group/group-introduction.xml: updated the parallel Composition relationship text to match the current Composition scope.
